---
title: "About OWAS"
description: "Purpose and current stage of the Open Workforce Analytics Standard."
---

OWAS is an open reference project around workforce measurement, people analytics, metric definitions, temporal data, data architecture, and related research.

The project aims to make assumptions visible and calculations reproducible. Its name describes an ambition; the v0.1 examples do not imply endorsement by a standards body or an established governance process.

## Scope

Standards record definitions. Research documents analysis. Essays explore interpretation. The dashboard provides access to separately hosted reports.

## Current stage

The initial release establishes the website and contribution structure. Authorship, stewardship, and licensing decisions should be documented as the project develops.
